import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def brute(tables, alpha):
    k = len(tables); start = tuple([0]*k); seen = {start}; fr=[start]
    while fr:
        nf=[]
        for st in fr:
            for t in range(alpha):
                nxt = tuple(tables[j][st[j]][t] for j in range(k))
                if nxt not in seen: seen.add(nxt); nf.append(nxt)
        fr = nf
    return len(seen)

rng = random.Random(9)
toks = ['a','b','c']
cases = []
for trial in range(60):
    atoms=[]; seen=set()
    while len(atoms) < rng.randint(1,5):
        p = tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(rng.randint(0,6)))
        op = rng.choice(['match','startswith','endswith','contains'])
        if (op,p) not in seen: seen.add((op,p)); atoms.append((op,p))
    cases.append(atoms)
ok = True
for cap in (1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 40, 200, 20000):
    m.MAX_PRODUCT = cap
    for atoms in cases:
        tables = [m.make_monitor(op, list(p), toks)[0] for (op,p) in atoms]
        r = m.product_reachable_count(tables, len(toks))
        b = brute(tables, len(toks))
        expect = -1 if b > cap else b
        if r != expect:
            print('CAP MISMATCH cap', cap, atoms, r, b); ok = False
m.MAX_PRODUCT = 20000
print('cap threshold check', 'OK' if ok else 'FAIL')
EOF
